stories.label: US sends 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran; Tehran's military rejects talks
stories.summary: US sends 15-point ceasefire via Pakistan including nuclear dismantlement and Hormuz reopening. 82nd Airborne deploying 1,000+ troops simultaneously. Iran military spokesman: 'Don't dress up your defeat as an agreement.'

stories.label: Bellingcat: Chad strike munitions match Chinese-made bombs used by RSF
stories.summary: Bellingcat identifies Chinese-made GB25A/GB50A bomb remnants at Tiné, Chad strike site (17 killed). Amnesty linked GB50A to RSF via UAE re-export. Proves RSF strikes beyond Sudan.

stories.label: ECB Lagarde signals rate hikes possible for Iran war inflation overshoot
stories.summary: Lagarde: ECB could tighten even for 'not-too-persistent' inflation from Iran war energy shock. Markets price 2-3 hikes in 2026. Firms may pass costs faster because 2022 inflation changed behavior.

stories.label: Iran internet at 1% for 600+ hours — 26 days of near-total blackout
stories.summary: NetBlocks: Iran 1% connectivity for 600+ hours (26 days). Longest sustained national internet shutdown in a warzone. 88 million people digitally isolated.

stories.label: Drones from Russia hit Estonian power plant, enter Latvian airspace
stories.summary: Russian drones entered Estonian and Latvian airspace, one hitting Auvere power plant. Estonia convened emergency session. Third Baltic incident in a week.

stories.label: Pakistan builds app-based fuel rationing for motorcycles/rickshaws
stories.summary: Pakistan finalizing CNIC-linked mobile app for fuel quotas on 2/3-wheelers. Rs70bn cost of holding prices for two weeks. Kerosene +128%, jet fuel +150% since war.

stories.label: Gold worst losing streak since 1920; bitcoin outperforms as wartime hedge
stories.summary: Gold 10-day losing streak (worst since Feb 1920), down 27% from ATH to $4,090. Bitcoin holds $70k+, BTC/gold ratio up 30%. Bitcoin ETFs +$2.5B March inflows vs gold ETF outflows.

stories.label: ICML rejects 497 papers after catching AI-generated peer reviews via watermarks
stories.summary: ICML caught 506 reviewers using LLMs via hidden watermarks in papers (170k phrase library). 497 papers rejected. First conference to offer opt-in LLM streams; cheating happened in no-LLM stream.

stories.label: Pakistan cities projected for 1/3 of global urban heat deaths by 2050
stories.summary: Climate Impact Lab: Faisalabad +9,400 heat deaths/yr by 2050 (vs Phoenix 600, Madrid 525). 8 Pakistani cities in global top 15. 10x more deaths in low-income vs high-income countries.

stories.label: Iran demands Vance as interlocutor, rejects Kushner and Witkoff
stories.summary: Iran informed Trump administration it prefers JD Vance as negotiating counterpart, rejecting Witkoff and Kushner. Tactic to split hawkish consensus.

stories.label: US expands visa bonds to 50 countries — financial barrier to Global South travel
stories.summary: 50 countries now require bonds up to $15k for US tourist/business visas. 12 new countries added April 2. Mostly African/Global South nations.

stories.label: Israel drops all charges against Sde Teiman soldiers who abused Palestinian detainee
stories.summary: Israel dropped all charges against soldiers filmed abusing Palestinian detainee at Sde Teiman. Military justice accountability exposed as theater.

stories.label: Meta drops E2EE from Instagram DMs, WANA users at highest risk
stories.summary: Meta removes end-to-end encryption from Instagram DMs effective May 8. SMEX warns acute risk for West Asia/North Africa users.

stories.label: Merck acquires Terns Pharmaceuticals for $6.7B (leukemia drug TERN-701)
stories.summary: Merck paying $6.7B for Terns Pharma and TERN-701 leukemia drug. Terns stock 6x'd in 6 months. Merck building pipeline as Keytruda patent cliff approaches.

stories.label: Bombing Gulf oil facilities causing environmental contamination lasting decades
stories.summary: SciDev: bombing of Gulf oil facilities contaminating air, soil and water systems. Environmental damage could persist for decades.

stories.label: Lebanon has no telecom emergency plan 15 months after 2024 war
stories.summary: SMEX: Lebanon telecom ministry has no emergency connectivity plan. Southern networks still unrepaired. Government fast-tracked Starlink for select entities only.

stories.label: Israeli QR code propaganda leaflets harvest Lebanese device data
stories.summary: Israeli aircraft dropping leaflets in Lebanon with QR codes that harvest device data and expose WhatsApp numbers to intelligence. SMEX published technical breakdown.

stories.label: Man arrested for shouting "No water, no light" at Niger State governor
stories.summary: Hamisu Abdullahi arrested for 5 days after shouting about lack of basic services during Governor Bago Eid visit. IPI lists Bago in Book of Infamy.

stories.label: UK inflation 3% in February — last clean reading before Iran war shock
stories.summary: UK CPI held at 3% in February. BoE now expects 3.5% by Q3 from Iran war energy shock. Markets flipped from rate cuts to rate hikes.

stories.label: Crypto exchanges launch 24/7 oil trading as wartime gaps exposed
stories.summary: Wintermute launched OTC crude oil CFDs. Crypto filling tradfi gaps when markets closed during Iran war weekends.

stories.label: AHF warns donor withdrawal threatens Nigeria HIV/TB treatment
stories.summary: AIDS Healthcare Foundation warns international donor pullback threatens HIV/TB gains. Nigeria must build domestic health financing.

stories.label: Benzene leaking from gas cookers in 10% of European homes tested
stories.summary: Study: 10% of homes tested in UK, NL, Italy had benzene leaks from gas cookers exceeding safety limits. Levels 66x higher than US in Netherlands.

stories.label: Telegram Drug King Park extradited from Philippines to South Korea
stories.summary: Park Wang-yeol (48), who ran Telegram-based meth empire from Philippine prison and murdered 3 Koreans, extradited to South Korea.

stories.label: Karachi court orders K-Electric to pay Rs50.6m for electrocution deaths
stories.summary: Court directed K-Electric to pay Rs50.6m to heirs of father and son who died from electrocution in 2006. 20 years from negligence to compensation.

stories.label: Ripple tests RLUSD stablecoin trade finance in Singapore MAS sandbox
stories.summary: Ripple entered Singapore MAS BLOOM sandbox to test RLUSD stablecoin for trade finance settlement.

stories.label: ATM geolocation links R11m cash deposits to ex-Eskom boss Molefe
stories.summary: Daily Maverick investigation: ATM data links R11m in cash deposits to ex-Eskom/Transnet boss Brian Molefe properties. State capture forensics.

stories.label: Heat in early pregnancy linked to fewer male births across Africa
stories.summary: Study finds warmer temperatures during first trimester in Africa selectively harm male fetuses, shifting population sex ratios.

stories.label: Google TurboQuant: extreme AI model compression for edge hardware
stories.summary: Google Research TurboQuant achieves extreme quantization, making large AI models viable on constrained hardware.

stories.label: Chemical bonding manipulation unlocks ionic thermoelectrics
stories.summary: Nature Communications: manipulating chemical bonding character makes ionic-bonded materials viable thermoelectrics for waste heat recovery.

stories.label: ML model predicts best cancer types for drug mechanisms
stories.summary: Nature Precision Oncology: representation learning on real-world data predicts which cancer indications best match a drug mechanism.
